title: Lightly Grilled German Pork Skewers
description: A winey and light German dish featuring apricot jam and char-grill flavors, perfect for a sick day, cooked on a salt block to enhance the flavor, this dish is nut-free-friendly and suitable for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the salt block to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together apricot jam, red wine, olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally
Cook the pork to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the pork skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
